22:37 Local Time, 17:07 GMT, 22:37 IST: The demolition act is completed as India clean-sweep Afghanistan 3-0. Chasing a daunting total was always tough for Afghans, and they lost wickets at regular intervals, which didn't help the cause. The Indian bowlers hunted as a group as they didn't let the home team to get away with the chase and they were bundled out for 92 runs. But it was Abhishek Sharma, who the stole the show today with a record breaking ton, which blew away the home team. Sanju gasve him good company with a fifty, but India lost the momentum in the middle and easily they could have added few more runs. Afghanistan started the chase badly losing 3 wickets inside two overs. Nitish Reddy and Ravi Bishnoi ended up taking 3 wickets as India romped home comfortably.
